content: Satya pratishtayam kriya phala ashrayatvam. (When established in absolute truthfulness, one's actions naturally yield their rightful fruits).
author: Patanjali
explanation: Total alignment with truth (*Satya*) harmonizes one's thoughts, words, and deeds with cosmic order, giving words immense moral weight and constructive power.
practicalInsight: Practice radical, compassionate honesty in all your communications today. Say exactly what is true without exaggeration or deceptive hedging.
reflectionPrompt: Is there any area of my life where partial truth is compromising my inner integrity?
